what_worked: Coherent thesis arc from AI premium to growth divergence to capital deployment recommendation is genuinely purposeful.
fix_next: Replace every stock/AI-generated infographic with charts built from the actual frozen dataset using real category names and counts.
verdict: Compelling thesis built entirely on fabricated numbers and decorative stock visuals.
factual_error_detail: Slide 3: AI shown as 312 (actual 197); categories Finance 128, HR & Recruiting 64, Security 42, Productivity 58 do not exist in dataset. Slide 4: category names (Digital Marketing, Healthcare Tech, Cybersecurity, Fintech, EdTech, IT Services, Non-Profit Tech) are fabricated; cites 'BizBuySell Insights' not the actual dataset; AI median multiple 3.15x unverifiable against reference multiples. Slide 5: AI growth 14.8%, market 23.3%, Dev Tools 62.5% are unverifiable from frozen data. Slide 6: bubble chart uses categories absent from dataset (Machine Learning, Data Infrastructure, Cloud Infrastructure, etc.). Slide 8: scorecard uses fictional companies (Northpeak, Catalyst, Greenflow, etc.) not in dataset. Slide 2: dashboard image is a generic real-estate template unrelated to data.

evidence.insight: Core thesis that AI commands premium multiples despite weaker growth is a genuinely interesting angle, but every supporting number is fabricated, so the insight is aspirational rather than demonstrated.
evidence.narrative: Clean arc: landscape → AI dominance → premium → growth divergence → synthesis → recommendation → limitations. Slide 10 limitations section is thoughtful. Sequence is purposeful even though content is hollow.
evidence.framing: Audience clearly defined as acquirer/investor (slides 2, 9). However, no disclosure of 274 missing categories, 216 zero-revenue rows, or 241 missing countries. Scope conflates the full 1,000-row dataset with the 262 on-sale subset without clarifying denominators.
evidence.accuracy: Nearly every quantitative claim is fabricated or unverifiable. Category names on slides 3-4-6 do not match the dataset. AI count inflated from 197 to 312. Source attribution to 'BizBuySell Insights' on slide 4 is false. Scorecard on slide 8 uses entirely fictional companies. Growth percentages on slide 5 cannot be traced to frozen data.
evidence.visual: Every data visualization is a pre-made stock infographic or AI-generated illustration rather than a chart built from actual data. Slide 2 uses a real-estate dashboard mockup. Slides 3-6 use comic-book/cityscape style graphics that look polished but encode fabricated numbers. Slide 9 has broken word-wrapping. No chart is traceable to the dataset.
evidence.ai_slop: Pervasive. Every chart is decorative AI/stock art. Consulting buzzwords throughout ('asymmetric opportunity,' 'buy-low scale-fast acquisition windows'). Fictional company scorecard on slide 8. Generic dashboard on slide 2. Comic-book infographic style applied uniformly regardless of content.

change_reason: Lowered accuracy from 2.5 to 2.0: identified additional fabrication (false source attribution slide 4, total of 9 errors vs 8). Lowered visual from 3.0 to 2.5: every single chart is stock/AI-generated art encoding fabricated data, which is worse than no charts at all since it actively misleads. Other dimensions confirmed as reasonable.
